mentions.name: TalonWatch
mentions.description: A passive security scanner for vibe-coded apps that surfaces exposed secrets and misconfigurations early, such as public Stripe keys or open databases. Offers a free surface scan with no account required.
mentions.problem: Founders often discover their Stripe keys were public or their database was wide open only after the damage is done; this makes those issues easier to catch early.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://talonwatch.com : I kept seeing founders discover their Stripe keys were public or their database was wide open, usually after the damage was done. Built a passive security scanner for vibe-coded apps so that's easier to catch early. Free surface scan, no account needed.
